ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF MARCH 25, 2008 AND REGULAR MEETING OF APRIL 22, 2008.
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meetings of March 25, 2008 and April 22, 2008.
Minutes 3/25/2008
Minutes 4/22/2008
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING AN ALTERNATING FRIDAY 9/80 SCHEDULE
It is recommended that the City Council continue the current 9/80 schedule and implement 7:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. as the operating hours on scheduled Fridays, the Holiday Bank, and the employee flex lunch schedule in order to maintain the present level of services available to the public on all regular scheduled operating days.
9/80 Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
RECESS CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
SPECIAL MEETING
LA PUENTE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
COUNCIL CHAMBERS - 15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
MAY 13, 2008 at 7:00 P.M.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-4
REQUEST TO CONSIDER RESOLUTION ENDORSING THE FIVE KEY PRINCIPLES OF THE SPEED MATTERS INITIATIVE (Requested by Mayor Lujan)
None.
High Speed Internet Report
Attachment A, B, C
Attachment D
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL (CONTINUED)
C-2
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A RESOULTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION 04-4378 AND ADOPTING THE LA PUENTE PARK USER GUIDE
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) provide direction regarding the percentage of residents required to receive the 1/3 fee charged for facility; and 2) adopt Resolution No. 08-4708, rescinding Resolution No. 04-4378; and 3) approve the La Puente Park User Guide.
Park User Guide Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
C-3
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENT OF REPRESENTATIVES TO THE SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF GOVERNMENTS
It is recommended that the City Council 1) select an alternate representative to serve on the Southern California Association of Governments; and 2) adopt Resolution No. 08-4709, appointing specific representatives to the Southern California Association of Governments.
SCAG Report
Attachment A
C-4
CONSIDERATION OF SCHOLARSHIP AWARDS TO LA PUENTE RESIDENTS
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Education Commission's recommendation and award 21 scholarships at $500 each for FY 2008-2009.
Scholarship Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
Attachment C
C-5
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTIONS OVERTURNING THE PLANNING COMMISSION/DEVELOPMENT REVIEW BOARD’S DECISIONS TO APPROVE UUP-239/DPA-1048 FOR PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1009 HACIENDA BLVD.
Staff recommends that the City Council 1) adopt Resolution No. 08-4710, overturning the Planning Commission’s decision and denying Unclassified Use Permit No. 239; and 2) adopt Resolution No. 08-4711, overturning the Development Review Board’s decision and denying Development Plan Application No. 1048.
UUP 239 Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
C-6
CONSIDERATION OF A REQUEST TO REVIEW EXISTING COMMISSION AND COMMITTEE APPOINTMENTS (Requested by Mayor Lujan and Mayor Pro Tem Holloway)
It is recommended that the City Council, (1) adopt Resolution No. 08-4712, rescinding Resolution No. 08-4428 and disbanding the Business Development Commission; (2) direct staff as to what changes, if any, to be made to the Education Commission duties; (3) adopt Resolution No. 08-4713, changing the expiration dates of the Parks & Recreation Commission and Education Commission; and (4) direct staff to immediately begin a recruitment for the Parks & Recreation Commission and Education Commission with terms that would begin upon appointment and terminate on January 30, 2009.
Commission/Committee Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
Attachment C
Attachment D
Attachment E
C-7
UPDATE FROM COMMUNITY FORUM DISCUSSION ON SEWER RECONSTRUCTION PROJECTS AND SEWER RATE STUDY
It is recommended that the City Council receive the update from the Community Forum and provide Staff with any comments on the content in the staff report.
Community Forum Update Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1226 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-08
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 08-4714.
Warrant Register 1226 Resolution
D-2
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR LEFT TURN SIGNAL INSTALLATION ON TEMPLE AVENUE AT CALIFORNIA AVENUE, ORANGE AVENUE AND SUNSET AVENUE
It is recommended that the City Council 1) approve the plans and specifications; and 2) authorize staff to solicit bids for the left turn signal installation project on Temple Avenue at California Avenue, Orange Avenue and Sunset Avenue.
Signal Installation Report
Attachment A
D-3
AUTHORIZATION TO AWARD BID FOR PURCHASE OF A FORD ESCAPE HYBRID TO PUENTE HILLS FORD
It is recommended that City Council: (1) Award the purchase of one (1) new 2008 Ford Escape Hybrid FWD to Puente Hills Ford for the total price of $28,205.05; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 08-4715, appropriating $2,500.00 from the AQMD fund to Line Item No. 42-4610-4484-70 for the purchase of one (1) new 2008 Ford Escape Hybrid FWD for the Public Works Director.
Vehicle Purchase Report
Attachment A & B
Attachment C
D-4
APPROVAL TO PARTICIPATE IN THE 2008 SUMMER FOOD SERVICE PROGRAM
It is recommended that City Council 1) authorize staff to submit an application to the State of California, Department of Education to participate in the 2008 Summer Food Service Program; and 2) authorize the Recreation Director to execute all Summer Food Service Program documents, including the attached agreement with Hacienda La Puente Unified School District.
Summer Food Service Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
D-5
EXTENSION OF CONTRACT FOR LEAD AND ASBESTOS CONSULTING SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Mayor to execute Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 07-877 for Community Development Block Grant program lead and asbestos consultant services with Global Environmental Training and Consulting for Fiscal Year 2008-09.
Lead & Asbestos Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
D-6
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR ROOF REPLACEMENT FOR THE SENIOR CENTER IMPROVEMENT PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) adopt budget Resolution No. 08-4716, increasing the FY 2007-08 budget for the Senior Center Improvement Project from $105,310 to $216,389; and 2) award the contract for the roof replacement portion of the Senior Center Improvement Project to Best Contracting Services in the amount of $88,537.00 and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on its behalf.
Roof Replacement Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
Attachment C
D-8
ACCEPTANCE OF SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT AND RESOLUTION FOR THE HACIENDA BOULEVARD AND ELLIOTT INTERSECTION MODIFICATIONS AND NEW TRAFFIC SIGNAL AT AMAR ROAD AND ELLIOTT AVENUE PROJECT
It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 08-4717, approving the supplemental agreement with Caltrans for Hazard Elimination System funds.
Intersection & Traffic Signal Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
D-7
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR THE UNRUH AVENUE STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT TEMPLE AVENUE TO AMAR ROAD
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) approve the plans and specifications; and 2) authorize Staff to solicit bids for the Unruh Avenue Street Improvement Project Temple Avenue to Amar Road.
Street Improvements Report
Attachment A
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL (Continued)
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF QUARTERLY CRIME REPORT PRESENTED BY LIEUTENANT BALTAZAR, INDUSTRY STATION
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the crime report as presented.
Crime Stats Report
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVING THE COMMUNITY CENTER LED SIGN
It is recommended that City Council approve changing the original wording on the LED sign from "La Puente Community Center" to "La Puente Community Complex."
Community Center LED Sign Report

Attachment B-1
Attachment B-2

E-3
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A POLICY TO CONDUCT TOURS OF CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS AND LA PUENTE HISTORICAL SOCIETY MUSEUM
It is recommended that the City Council approve the policy for conducting tours at City Hall and the La Puente Historical Society Museum.
City Hall Tours Report
